description: This file defines the interface for plugins within the WPEFramework, including plugin lifecycle, notification, web, websocket, security, and authentication interfaces. It declares classes, structs, and methods that plugins must implement or interact with.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface with lifecycle methods and notification/lifetime nested interfaces.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface supporting WebSocket channel attachment.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins managing notifications.

classes.name: IWeb
classes.description: Interface for handling web requests and responses.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security validation and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for creating tokens and officer security interface.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Notification callback when plugin is activated.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Notification callback when plugin is deactivated.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Notification callback when plugin becomes unavailable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initialize plugin with shell context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitialize plugin with shell context.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Retrieve plugin metadata as JSON string.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attach a communication channel to the plugin.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detach a communication channel from the plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification with the composite plugin.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a notification from the composite plugin.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming web request.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Process web request and generate response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming WebSocket message.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming JSON element from WebSocket.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming text socket message.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle raw inbound data on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Send raw data outbound on a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Check if a WebSocket upgrade is allowed.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Check if a request is allowed.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Check if a JSONRPC message is allowed.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Retrieve security token payload.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Create a security token.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Get security interface for a token.
